text:
Sophia Chen: Pushed a docs PR to align SOC2 audit-log wording + add SDK/curl examples for export & retention. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1298
Max Patel: Thanks — pinging Legal for wording review. My quick read: 'customer data' appears in two places, maybe we should be more specific (tenant-scoped vs PII).
Jordan Reyes: Can you paste the current snippet? I want to ensure the curl sample sets the correct accept header and shows redaction flag.
Sophia Chen: Snippet is at the bottom of the PR, but here's the curl example I added:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?tenant_id=acme-corp&redact=true
```
Lee Gomez: Small nit: use `X-Accept-Format: audit-json` instead of generic accept for docs clarity? Also show example TTL param (expires_in=30d).
Ria Singh: From Legal: prefer 'tenant audit events' rather than 'customer data' and avoid implying we store raw PII after redaction. Suggested phrasing: "Audit exports produce tenant-scoped events; PII is removed per configured redaction rules."
docs-bot: Automated linkcheck passed for changed pages. :white_check_mark:
Sophia Chen: Updated wording to match Legal suggestion. Also added a Python SDK example for export and a short note about retention TTL.
Sophia Chen: Python snippet:
```python
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.exports.create(tenant_id="acme-corp", redact=True, expires_in="30d")
print(resp.download_url)
```
Max Patel: Looks good. Can we also add a callout that export downloads are time-limited and that customers should rotate links if storing them externally?
Jordan Reyes: I'll add an inline note about presigned URLs expiring and recommend secure transfer. Also will add link to KMS docs for encryption at rest.
Lee Gomez: One more doc UX tweak: show 'before' and 'after' example of an audit record with PII redacted (single-line JSON). Helps readers understand redaction in practice.
Sophia Chen: Done — added one-line examples and updated tests for snippet linting. Requesting final review from @Ria and @Max.
Ria Singh: Approved phrasing. :thumbsup:
Max Patel: Approved from infra side. :white_check_mark:
Sophia Chen: Merging once CI completes. Thanks everyone for quick feedback! :party:
